Validator-bypass paths (model_construct, attribute assignment, since DatabaseConfig has no validate_assignment) were not counted because they are not 'load'. Impact is small: the empty-driver value would fail later when SQLAlchemy resolves the dialect, not at load, and the description's intent is otherwise accurate.
